ios.desc:
A story based on the dark web, told as a social networking app interaction (messages, feed, and more), as if you were using someone's social network account.

***
Story Background:
Tormento was a rising criminal social network in the dark web. It attracted the worst kinds of people in the world. For some reason you joined Tormento. And there's no going back.

***
